svg.text: This diagram shows the concrete records, routes, worker steps, checks, providers, and outcomes behind the product workflow.
A. Manual, research, reply, and batch entry
B. Automated source ingestion and source-backed drafting
C. Approval, job processing, browser posting, and history
D. Data records and state values
E. Codebase modules, runtime processes, and external dependencies

Source adapters currently wired by default: aggregated news and RSS. The aggregated news adapter fans out to Hacker News, Reddit, TechCrunch, arXiv, GitHub, GDELT, company RSS, hiring, and optional Product Hunt.
Daily posting uses the account limit plus deterministic variance and a hard cap. The current local configuration targets about 3–4 posts/day and enforces spacing.
These records are stored locally in SQLite, with a JSON fallback when SQLite cannot be used. Browser screenshots, traces, media, profiles, and logs stay on the local machine.
Runtime processes: web UI → API → worker → browser. Desktop can run API and worker in-process. CLI can call the same local system.
